Your testing setup probably has one tool for mobile, another for web, a third for accessibility and a fourth for devices. Each is fine on its own, but together they mean duplicated work and a lot of switching.

Testing doesn’t have to be scattered across tools. Here’s how we’re making it simpler, faster and less fragmented.

Match tests to what users actually do

Teams often organise tests by code structure. Try organising them by the journeys that matter most to the business instead. Coverage decisions get clearer, and you stop over-testing the quiet corners.
